name: @drawie/native
//: Phase 5 — Expo / React Native app (iOS + Android). DELIBERATELY NOT in the root npm `workspaces` array (see root package.json) so installing its React-Native deps can't disturb the verified web build. Install + run this on a machine with the RN toolchain: `cd apps/native && npm install && npx expo run:ios` (custom dev client — react-native-skia 2.x does NOT run in Expo Go). Versions below are starting points; verify against the current Expo SDK before first build.
//deps: @drawie/core + @drawie/data are resolved via tsconfig `paths` + Metro `extraNodeModules` (metro.config.js), NOT npm — they're TS source with no/own deps. Expo-managed native deps (expo-status-bar, react, react-native, react-native-gesture-handler, @shopify/react-native-skia) are added via `npx expo install` so versions match the installed Expo SDK (56 → RN 0.86). @supabase + AsyncStorage + url-polyfill are added in STEP 4/5 when the data layer is wired.
